name: What steps do you take to protect my property during paint and finish work?

mainEntity.name: What steps do you take to protect my property during paint and finish work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Protecting your property is a high priority during paint and finish work. Our crew takes comprehensive measures, including covering all furniture, flooring, and non-painted surfaces with drop cloths and plastic sheeting for interiors. For exteriors, we cover plants, walkways, and fixtures. We also meticulously tape off trim, windows, and other architectural features to ensure clean lines and prevent accidental paint transfer. Our team is trained to maintain a clean work environment throughout the project, ensuring your home remains tidy and undamaged.
acceptedAnswer.description: We protect your property by covering furniture, floors, and non-painted surfaces with drop cloths and plastic. Exterior elements like plants and walkways are also covered and taped.
